annotations.title: Wire list, wire markers and cable schedule

description:
Wiring exports of an installation as rows with stable column names (repérage des fils, carnet de
        câbles, liste d'E/S, borniers): what='markers' (one row per wire end, for label
        printers), 'wires' (wire list), 'cables' (cable schedule), 'io' (one row per PLC channel, connected or
        spare, with the device linked to it) or 'terminals' (one row per terminal of each terminal block). Marks
        follow the wire_marking rules of the view (id), by default the first view that declares them.

document.description: The uniwire document of the electrical installation: a JSON object, or its JSON text, as returned by get_example, apply_patch or normalize (a file path is accepted when the server runs locally).
document.title: Document

view.description: Id of a view of the document (its 'views' list); default: the first view of the requested kind.
view.title: View

what.description: 'markers' (one row per wire end, for label printers), 'wires' (wire list), 'cables' (cable schedule), 'io' (I/O list of the PLCs) or 'terminals' (terminal strip table).
what.title: What
